x: Bert Cook recorded his fastest time for some while to take second place; and third prize was claimed by A.
Syd Ring and Bert Cook were on the virtual scratch mark of one minute and to Ring falls the honour of doing the fastest time, viz., 29 min. 41 sec.
In fact, we had the first ten home, but as Bert Cook is only a second-claim member, he was eliminated from the scoring, and we had our 10 in 12.
Next for us came Syd Ring, striving to put every second possible between himself and the following men; then Bert Cook, the evergreen; and "Mick" Walker.
Tobin, of Belgrave, off 100, was second and Bert Cook, better known as a Poly Harrier, was third off 110 yards.
